facts.answer: XCScheme::EnvironmentVariables is an ordered mutable collection of :key, :value, and :enabled hashes; upsert preserves position, enables the entry, and action assignment serializes an EnvironmentVariables child. EnvironmentVariables.new accepts nil, an EnvironmentVariables REXML element, or an array of key/value/enabled hashes; []=(key, value) preserves both XML and collection position across reloaded XML and multiple existing entries.
